infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vantro checks you're within range of the job site when you sign in or out. No movement is tracked or recorded.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vantro uses the camera to capture site photos, defect evidence, and receipts for your work record.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vantro needs photo library access to attach images to reports.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Vantro uses your location only to confirm you're within range of a job site when signing in and out. No movement is tracked, recorded, or shared, location is checked at the site boundary only.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Used to confirm you're at the job site when signing in or out. No tracking, no movement recording.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Used to confirm you're at the job site when signing in or out. No tracking, no movement recording.

plugins.cameraPermission: Vantro uses the camera to capture site photos, defect evidence, and receipts for your work record.
